Interface ViewInterface

All Superinterfaces:
Remote, Serializable
All Known Subinterfaces:
DisplayableView, VirtualView
All Known Implementing Classes:
GUI, MockVirtualView, TUI, VirtualViewRMI, VirtualViewSocket
public interface ViewInterface extends Remote, Serializable
Interface for the view in the game, which handles all interactions and updates the client with the game's state. All methods in this interface are remotely called to update the view from the server.
